verdict.rationale: Shopify's UCP docs describe a concrete verifiable-identity system: agents present a profile (well-known/ucp with signing keys), traffic is classified into Token/Signed/Anonymous trust tiers, Signed-tier requests use RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures (ECDSA P-256) verified against the profile's published public key, and higher identification tiers unlock higher rate limits and sensitive tools (e.g., Order MCP and complete_checkout are Token-tier only). This directly gives merchants a mechanism to distinguish trusted agent traffic from anonymous bots. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that the tiering works as documented in production, and evidence of a merchant-facing dashboard/report that surfaces which incoming traffic is Token/Signed/Anonymous.
